# Spidermon monitors, validators and actions misbehaving — diagnosing without a test suite

I have been using this library to run monitor suites over scraped data and I am seeing a lot of things go wrong at once after picking up a new copy of the source. The repository has received 14 separate undocumented edits. Below is everything I have been able to pin down, grouped by the area where I noticed it. Several areas have a working neighbour right next to a broken one, which I have tried to note.

## Format checks in schema validation

The e-mail and URL format checks now give exactly the opposite verdict from the one they should. A well-formed address such as a normal `user@host.tld` is reported as *not* a valid e-mail, while a string that is obviously not an address at all is accepted. The same inversion happens for URLs: a proper `https://…` address is rejected, while a mistyped scheme or a bare host name with no scheme passes. Validating a document whose schema declares an e-mail or URL format therefore produces errors for the good values and stays silent for the bad ones. Feeding an absent/empty value into these checks still behaves as it always did — it is accepted.
